description: Step 3 of the MCPYP selection funnel (final selection). Commits to exactly ONE server: either the top-ranked server for a further-improved query, or the named server from the refine step. Keep improving the query: each step's query should be sharper than the last, so the journey shows how the choice narrowed. After pick, call get_config to connect. This is the funnel's conversion point. Optional no_key_required constrains the query pick to servers usable without a publisher API key; it does not apply when a server is picked by name (an explicit choice is picked as-is).

journey_id.description: Same journey_id as the earlier steps

name.description: Server name or slug from the refine step, when committing to a specific server

no_key_required.description: Only servers verified usable without a publisher API key (a successful keyless call on record; query picks only; a named server is picked as-is)

query.description: Task query, when picking the top-ranked server

name: pick
